report.title: [Prepared setup] Generator ghost state after payload explosion
report.body:
### Platforms

Windows

### Build

release build 159.7

### Issue

[RU] 
Генератор, заправленный взрывчатой смесью, может пережить собственный взрыв, если он стоит на грузовом конвейере. В результате появляется генератор с 0 HP, который неуязвим, продолжает работать и ломает ИИ юнитов, пытающихся с ним взаимодействовать. При перезаходе на сохранение, генератор теряет забагованные свойства, и становится просто блоком с 0 хп.
Демонстрация бага и его воспроизведения будет прикреплена в виде записи экрана (Простите за плохое качество и фреймрейт, мой ноутбук лучше не запишет)

[EN (DeepSeek translate)]
A generator can survive its own explosion if it is placed on a payload conveyor while fueled with Blast Compound. The resulting block has 0 HP, is indestructible, still functions, and can break enemy AI pathfinding. After reloading the save, the generator loses its bugged properties and becomes a normal block with 0 HP.
A video demonstration of the bug and its reproduction is included as a screen recording.
Please excuse the low resolution and framerate — my laptop is not capable of capturing higher quality footage.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Ikw9oJ3dS4ffMi4ViG005SJQR1KysG-m/view?usp=sharing

### Steps to reproduce

[RU]
- Поставьте ГВС/Паровой генератор, и запитайте его взрывчатой смесью;
- Дайте ему повредиться, и подхватите юнитом;
- Выгрузите генератор на грузовой конвейер, и подождите до взрыва (Важно: "Взрывы реакторов" должны быть включены);
- Достаньте взорвавшийся генератор с конвейера юнитом, и установите его на землю.
Если у генератора пустая полоса здоровья, то баг удался. Ручную погрузку генератора можно заменить на грузовой загрузчик с Эрекира.

[EN (DeepSeek translate)]
- Place a Steam Generator (or Combustion generator) and fuel it with Blast Compound.
- Allow it to take damage, then pick it up using a unit.
- Unload the damaged generator onto a Payload Conveyor and wait for it to explode. (Important: Reactor explosions must be enabled in the game settings.)
- After it explodes, pick it up from the conveyor using a unit, and place it back on the ground.
If the generator has an empty health bar — the bug has successfully been triggered. Manual loading of the generator can be replaced with a payload loader from Erekir.

### Mods used

[RU]
Без модов

[EN]
No mods

### Save file

[RU]
Баг может быть воспроизведён на любом сохранении.

[EN (Google translater)]
The bug can be reproduced on any save.

### (Crash) logs

_No response_

### REPRO video/setup assistance (not part of the upstream report)

This fresh attempt is explicitly assisted. Codex inspected sampled frames of the original report's linked 331.267-second, 780x438 video on September 15 JST. Those frames are third-party report material, not a fresh REPRO reproduction.

Observed setup in the original video: around 25 seconds a placed Payload Source has a configuration panel with a search field and unit choices. Around 35-55 seconds there is a Steam Generator with adjacent resource sources, a water bar and nonzero power output. The player controls a green payload-capable flying unit; a separate Payload Conveyor is placed nearby. Around 65 seconds the generator is on that conveyor with a visible effect. Later (around 105-115 seconds) hovering the placed Steam Generator shows an empty health bar, water and nonzero power output. Sampled frames do not establish every intermediate input or the exact unit identity.

General setup facts checked in this historical source, not a diagnosis or fix: Payload Source is in the Units category, is 5x5 and requires sandbox/infinite resources. Its configuration combines block and unit choices, so use its search field to find a unit by name rather than guessing an icon. Mega is a payload-capable flying unit with capacity for a 2x2 building. Confirm actual unit output, then use Ctrl-click to control it. Default pickup/drop keys are [ and ]; Space pauses time, E pauses construction, and sustained movement needs keypress hold_seconds.

For Steam Generator, configure an Item Source with Blast Compound and a Liquid Source with Water and verify actual delivery and generator operation before the damage/pickup sequence. Allow enough open terrain for the large source and the flight/transport route. A blank editor map with a friendly core can be saved and played as a custom Sandbox map if existing terrain makes setup difficult. Record the actual rules/mode; editor invulnerability would invalidate a damage test. Reactor explosions must be enabled as the original report says.

Keep checkpoints for generator present and fueled, damaged but alive, loaded on conveyor, explosion/effect, then retrieved and placed with its health and operation inspected. A missing item, unbuilt outline, normal payload drawing or an unexecuted step is not the reported ghost-state bug. Stop with a clear setup limitation if those prerequisites cannot be reached. No historical developer fix, future source or root-cause hint was supplied.


### REPRO operator-prepared saved scene (explicit additional assistance)

This variant begins from a small prepared SAVE GAME supplied at /workspace/fixtures/operator-generator-setup.msav. It is not an original player attachment. Import it using Play > Load Game > Import Save (follow the actual UI labels), then load the saved game. Importing it only as an editor map may omit the saved unit entities, so verify that the units are present in gameplay.

The scene was constructed with the unchanged historical game's normal objects and native SaveIO serializer. It uses a flat 160x120 stone map, a friendly Sharded core and normal Sandbox rules (editor=false, infinite resources=true, reactor explosions=true, no automatic wave timer). The construction audit saved and reloaded the file and checked healthy initial objects and empty conveyors. This is a precondition audit, not a bug reproduction, candidate test or an AI result. There is no damaged, dead or ghost object embedded in the file.

The scene has one healthy Steam Generator at tile (84,60), a Water-configured Liquid Source to its west at (83,60), an UNCONFIGURED Item Source to its east at (86,60), an empty right-facing Payload Conveyor at (96,60), and one healthy Mega near (82,56). Native source delivery was checked: water reaches the generator; it starts without fuel at full health. Camera metadata is near tile (86,60), but choose screen coordinates from the actual image.

First inspect the healthy setup and control the Mega. The AI must configure the Item Source with Blast Compound, establish actual damage, perform pickup and transport onto the conveyor, observe the explosion, then retrieve/place the object and check its health and operation. Pause time deliberately when needed for the timing-sensitive steps; normal gameplay damage must occur with editor mode disabled. The construction source supplies no root-cause diagnosis or future patch.

summary: The prepared save was imported through Load Game and tested in gameplay. The Steam Generator was visibly supplied with Water and Blast Compound, showed 132.0 power output, and later showed nonfatal health loss while fueled. I controlled the supplied Mega and attempted pickup/transport, but did not obtain a confirmed Steam Generator payload on the conveyor, a visible post-explosion retrievable payload, or a placed empty/0-HP generator. The reported anomalous state was therefore not established.

spec.summary: Unverified report: a damaged Blast-Compound-fueled generator, described inconsistently as a Steam Generator and possibly a Combustion Generator, allegedly remains placeable with an empty/0-HP health bar after exploding on a Payload Conveyor. The reporter further alleges that the placed block remains operational and indestructible, affects unit AI behavior, and loses those properties after the save is reloaded.
spec.bug_class: Unverified anomalous post-explosion building-state behavior involving payload transport
spec.observed_behavior: Player-reported only, not independently verified: after a generator is damaged, loaded onto a Payload Conveyor, and allowed to explode, the reporter says it can be picked up and placed again. The resulting placed block is alleged to show an empty health bar/0 HP, remain operational, be invulnerable, and disrupt AI behavior of units attempting to interact with it. The reporter says reloading the save removes the alleged anomalous properties, leaving a normal block with 0 HP. The report includes a Google Drive video link, but this normalization does not verify the video's availability, completeness, or contents.
spec.expected_behavior: Not explicitly stated by the reporter. Implied expectation: an exploded generator should not remain as a placeable, operational, indestructible 0-HP block or produce anomalous unit-AI interactions after payload retrieval and placement.
known_preconditions: Reporter states that no mods were used.
The in-game "Reactor explosions" setting must be enabled according to the reported steps.
The reported generator must be fueled with Blast Compound.
The generator is reportedly damaged before it is picked up.
The generator is reportedly placed on a Payload Conveyor and allowed to explode.
The reported sequence retrieves the post-explosion payload with a unit and places it back onto terrain.
The reporter asserts that the issue can be reproduced on any save.
uncertain_conditions: Whether the reported behavior occurs at all; no independent reproduction is represented here.
The exact block type is unclear: the Russian text and machine translations refer to a Steam Generator and/or a Combustion Generator.
The exact build identity is incomplete: "release build 159.7" is reported, but the distribution channel, full revision, and relationship to the supplied target commit are not established.
The damage source, amount, timing, and confirmation that the generator is still alive before conveyor loading are not provided.

The payload-capable unit identity, loading method, conveyor direction/layout, and timing of pickup after the explosion are not fully specified. Manual loading and an Erekir payload loader are both mentioned as possible methods.
The map, game mode, rules, editor state, invulnerability settings, team setup, and whether the session is single-player or multiplayer are not reported.
The exact Blast Compound, water, power, and other source configurations are not documented.
It is unclear how "still functions" was determined, such as measured power output, fuel consumption, water use, or another observable operation test.
The claimed invulnerability is not accompanied by a damage attempt, weapon type, or evidence of failed destruction.

The claimed AI impact is not described precisely; affected unit types, AI mode, interaction target, and observable failure are unknown. The English translation calls this pathfinding, while the original Russian wording is broader.
The reload behavior is not fully specified, including the save point used, whether the game was fully restarted, and how the post-reload 0-HP block was inspected.

The linked video is an external artifact whose accessibility and provenance are unverified. Supplemental statements about sampled historical frames are not a fresh reproduction and do not establish all inputs.
The supplied operator-prepared save is explicitly a setup aid rather than a player-produced affected save; it does not establish the reported state.
reproduction_hints: Reported sequence, unverified: start a session with reactor explosions enabled and with no mods as claimed by the reporter.
Place the reported generator type, configure it to receive Blast Compound, and ensure it is operating as applicable for that block.
Cause unspecified nonfatal damage to the generator, then pick it up with a payload-capable unit or use the alternatively mentioned payload-loading method.
Place the damaged generator onto a Payload Conveyor and wait for the reported explosion.
Attempt to retrieve the purported post-explosion payload with a unit and place it on terrain.

Inspect and record the health bar, whether the block operates, whether it can be damaged or destroyed, and any unit-AI behavior around it. The reporter treats an empty health bar as the primary success indicator.
Reload the same save and compare the placed block's health and behavior before versus after reload.

Record each intermediate state, because the report does not establish whether the generator was damaged-but-alive, successfully loaded, actually exploded, or remained retrievable in every attempted run.
required_artifacts: Missing: a player-generated save file from before the sequence and an affected save captured after the alleged 0-HP block is placed. A further save after reload would be needed to document the claimed state change.

Missing or requiring access verification: the original downloadable screen recording behind the Google Drive link, preferably the unedited file with timestamps and a checksum. The external URL alone is not independently verifiable evidence.
Missing: exact game version details, including full build/revision, distribution channel, and whether the reported Windows build corresponds to the supplied evaluation commit.

Missing: screenshots or a continuous recording of the rules/settings screen, especially "Reactor explosions," game mode, editor status, invulnerability-related settings, and relevant sandbox/custom-map rules.

Missing: exact block names and source configurations, including the generator variant, Blast Compound delivery method, water/power configuration if applicable, payload unit or loader, conveyor layout, and damage method.
Missing: evidence for each claimed property of the placed 0-HP block: health display, operational output/consumption, attempted damage or destruction, and the alleged AI interaction failure.
Missing: normal client/runtime logs from an affected session and server logs if multiplayer was involved. No crash logs were supplied, and the report does not claim a crash.
Missing: a mod/content list or diagnostic export sufficient to corroborate the no-mod claim.
Available but insufficient: the operator-provided `operator-generator-setup.msav` is described as a healthy setup scene only, not an affected player save or proof of the report.

hypotheses.statement: A damaged, blast-fueled Steam Generator continues updating as a BuildPayload on a Payload Conveyor; once its health reaches zero, the conveyor retains it for pickup and it can be placed at 0 HP.
hypotheses.prediction: After configuring Blast Compound, damaging the healthy generator, loading it on the prepared conveyor, and waiting, the conveyor will still visually contain a Steam Generator payload and the retrieved/placed block will show an empty health bar.
hypotheses.observation: UI testing confirmed the supplied Steam Generator could be fed Water and Blast Compound (displaying 132.0 power output) and it then showed nonfatal ground damage. A Mega was controlled, but the attempted pickup/transport sequence did not yield a confirmed visible conveyor payload or a placed 0-HP generator before the clean replay had to stop.
